title: Band Member 1 - The DJ

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Vibes! You here for the release party?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Vibes! You here for the release party?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What release party?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What release party?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Mr. Music man, how are you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mr. Music man, how are you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Mr. Music man, how are you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Mr. Music man, how are you?

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: "The Sarcasm Sandys!" Where you been, fool?! It's their first record in over six years!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "The Sarcasm Sandys!" Where you been, fool?! It's their first record in over six years!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Never heard of them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never heard of them.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Six years? Why so long?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Six years? Why so long?

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: And here I thought you could hear the sound, but I guess them ears are just like the others.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And here I thought you could hear the sound, but I guess them ears are just like the others.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Eh, typical band problems. Lead singer never really said what they wanted, kept changing the lyrics half-way through live shows, just causing chaos.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, typical band problems. Lead singer never really said what they wanted, kept changing the lyrics half-way through live shows, just causing chaos.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Chaos is good for creativity.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Chaos is good for creativity.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like they need a new lead singer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like they need a new lead singer.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like they need a new lead singer.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like they need a new lead singer.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why haven't they released an album in so long?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why haven't they released an album in so long?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why haven't they released an album in so long?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why haven't they released an album in so long?

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: A day in the life of an artist, yah know? Either way, I'm stoked! I can't wait to hear the new tracks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A day in the life of an artist, yah know? Either way, I'm stoked! I can't wait to hear the new tracks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: When does it come out?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When does it come out?

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Oh.... like next week.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh.... like next week.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait, then why are you here already?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait, then why are you here already?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Wait, then why are you here already?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Wait, then why are you here already?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Oh, so you have some time to kill! Great!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, so you have some time to kill! Great!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Oh, so you have some time to kill! Great!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Oh, so you have some time to kill! Great!

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Feelin' the jams. Rockin' the bands. Waitin for new music to drop. Livin life in the vibes, yah know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Feelin' the jams. Rockin' the bands. Waitin for new music to drop. Livin life in the vibes, yah know?

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: What can I say? Groupie gonna group.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What can I say? Groupie gonna group.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: I mean we have different definitions of the word "great", but sure! Something you need?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean we have different definitions of the word "great", but sure! Something you need?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not me, Fauxter Glambeat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not me, Fauxter Glambeat.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Foxy Fauxter? What's that pop-synth got you running around for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Foxy Fauxter? What's that pop-synth got you running around for?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We're getting the band back together.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We're getting the band back together.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: We're getting the band back together.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: We're getting the band back together.

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Ahhhh! No way! Which one though: The Glam Sham Bam-o-Ram? Or Meddling Middle Children? Wait! Wasn't his last one The Tiger Trio?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ahhhh! No way! Which one though: The Glam Sham Bam-o-Ram? Or Meddling Middle Children? Wait! Wasn't his last one The Tiger Trio?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not sure. All of them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not sure. All of them?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He didn't mention those names...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He didn't mention those names...

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Hahaha. That's just like FG. Faux has had more bands than anyone I know. Tryin' to find that creative cohesion.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hahaha. That's just like FG. Faux has had more bands than anyone I know. Tryin' to find that creative cohesion.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well? What do you say?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well? What do you say?

nodes.speaker: Finn Amano
nodes.text: Ehhh, why not? I can give the tables a spin with the crew and see if we can come up with something. Let's drop them sounds!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ehhh, why not? I can give the tables a spin with the crew and see if we can come up with something. Let's drop them sounds!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Any fond memories of Fauxter Glambeat?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Any fond memories of Fauxter Glambeat?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Any fond memories of Fauxter Glambeat?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Any fond memories of Fauxter Glambeat?
